title: Windows-Copilot-API repository and Microsoft Copilot site were linked
summary: On 2026-06-22, the available record linked the Windows-Copilot-API GitHub repository alongside Microsoft's Copilot website. This establishes a dated public reference point for the project's development line, but does not establish a release, feature set, ownership, or deployment status.
